name: Hover
summary: When this unit takes to the skies, it does not subtract 2" from its maximum move distance.

name: Advanced Firepower
summary: This model's twin iliastus accelerator cannon gains Lethal Hits against non-Monster, non-Vehicle targets; its twin arachnus heavy blaze cannon gains Lethal Hits against Monster or Vehicle targets.

name: Assault Dropship
summary: A unit that disembarks from this transport before it moves may still charge this turn even if it Advanced.

name: Assault Ramp
summary: A unit that disembarks from this transport after making a Normal move remains eligible to declare a charge that turn.

name: Auramite and Adamantine
summary: Once per battle, at the start of any phase, this model can reduce the Damage of every attack allocated to it to 1 until the end of that phase.

name: Captain-General
summary: While this model leads a unit, models in that unit ignore all modifiers to their Ballistic Skill, Weapon Skill, or Hit roll characteristics.

name: Corner the Quarry
summary: Each non-Monster, non-Vehicle enemy unit within Engagement Range of this model that Falls Back must take a Desperate Escape test, at -1 if it is Battle-shocked.

name: CUSTODIAN GUARD
summary: If an Adeptus Custodes model with the Leader ability could be attached to a Custodian Guard unit, it can be attached to this unit instead.

name: Daughter of the Abyss
summary: This model has Feel No Pain 3+ against Psychic Attacks and against mortal wounds.

name: Daughters of the Abyss
summary: This model has Feel No Pain 3+ against Psychic Attacks and mortal wounds.

name: Deft Parry
summary: Each melee attack that targets this unit has -1 applied to its Hit roll.

name: Devoted to Destruction
summary: If this model is equipped with two Telemon caestus weapons in addition to its armoured feet weapon, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of those Telemon caestus weapons.

name: Disintegration Beams
summary: Once per battle, at the start of your Shooting phase, this unit's ranged weapons gain the Devastating Wounds ability until the end of the phase.

name: Dread Foe
summary: When this model fights, roll one D6 (+2 if it made a Charge move this turn) against an enemy unit within Engagement Range: on 4-5 it suffers D3 mortal wounds, on 6+ it suffers 3 mortal wounds.

name: Fire Support
summary: After this transport shoots and hits an enemy unit, until the end of the phase, models that disembarked from it this turn may re-roll the Wound roll when attacking that unit.

name: From Golden Light
summary: Once per battle, at the end of the opponent's turn, if this unit is not within Engagement Range of any enemy unit, it can be removed from the battlefield and placed into Strategic Reserves.

name: Galatus Shield
summary: Each melee attack that targets this model has -1 applied to its Wound roll.

name: Golden Laurels
summary: While this model leads a unit, each melee attack that targets that unit has its Armour Penetration worsened by 1.

name: Guardian Eternal
summary: Each attack allocated to this model has its Damage characteristic reduced by 1.

name: Heavy Assault Infantry
summary: Each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack against the closest eligible target, it can re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

name: Hero of Lion’s Gate
summary: Once per battle, after making a Hit roll, Wound roll, or saving throw for this model, you can change that result to an unmodified 6.

name: Implacable Vanguard
summary: Once per battle, after this unit shoots, if it is not within Engagement Range of any enemy unit, it can make a Normal move of up to 6", but is then not eligible to charge that turn.

name: Infernus Firebombs
summary: At the end of your Movement phase, target one visible enemy unit (not AIRCRAFT/Lone Operative) within 24": it loses cover until your next Shooting phase, and suffers 1 mortal wound per 6 rolled, one D6 per model in that unit.

name: JETBIKE OUTRIDERS
summary: If a model with the Leader ability could be attached to a Vertus Praetors unit, it can be attached to this unit instead.

name: JUMP PACKS
summary: This unit cannot embark within a Venerable Land Raider.

name: LIONS OF THE EMPEROR
summary: If a model with the Leader ability could be attached to an Allarus Custodians unit, it can be attached to this unit instead.

name: Living Fortress
summary: Once per battle, at the start of any phase, this unit can gain the Feel No Pain 4+ ability until the end of that phase.

name: Martial Inspiration
summary: Once per battle, in your Charge phase, this model's unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

name: Master of the Stances
summary: Once per battle, when this model's unit is selected to fight, both Ka'tah Stances can be active for that unit simultaneously until the fight is resolved, instead of only one.

name: Merciless Hunter
summary: In your Shooting phase, each attack this model makes against an enemy unit that is Below Half-strength gains +1 to its Wound roll.

name: Moment Shackle
summary: Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, choose one until the end of the phase: this model's Watcher's Axe has an Attacks characteristic of 12, or this model gains a 2+ invulnerable save.

name: No Foe Shall Stand
summary: Once per battle, at the start of your Shooting phase, this unit's ranged weapons gain the Lethal Hits and Ignores Cover abilities until the end of the phase.

name: Praesidium Shield
summary: The bearer's Wounds characteristic is increased by 1.

name: Purity of Execution
summary: Each ranged attack a model in this unit makes against a Psyker unit gains the Precision and Devastating Wounds abilities.

name: Quicksilver Execution
summary: Once per battle, after this unit makes a Normal or Advance move, it can target one non-Monster, non-Vehicle enemy unit it moved over: roll one D6 per model in this unit, and that enemy unit suffers 2 mortal wounds for each roll of 2+.

name: Resolute Will
summary: While a Character leads this unit, each attack against it whose Strength exceeds this unit's Toughness has -1 applied to its Wound roll.

name: Sanctified Flames
summary: After this unit shoots, select one enemy unit it hit: that unit must take a Battle-shock test.

name: Saturation Volleys
summary: After this unit shoots, select one hit non-Monster, non-Vehicle enemy unit: until your next turn, while this unit remains on the battlefield, that enemy unit's attacks suffer -1 to their Hit roll.

name: Seeker’s Instincts
summary: While this model leads a unit, add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit and add 2 to Advance and Charge rolls made for it.

name: Sentinel Storm
summary: Once per battle, after this unit shoots in your Shooting phase, it can shoot again.

name: Slayers of Tyrants
summary: Each attack a model in this unit makes against a Character, Monster, or Vehicle unit can have its Wound roll re-rolled.

name: Stand Vigil
summary: Each attack a model in this unit makes can re-roll a Wound roll of 1, or re-roll the Wound roll entirely while the unit is within range of an objective marker it controls.

name: Strategic Mastery
summary: Once per battle round, select one model in your army with this ability: a Stratagem used to target that model's unit costs 1CP less.

name: Strike from the Skies
summary: This unit remains eligible to shoot and to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

name: Sweeping Advance
summary: Once per battle, at the end of the Fight phase, if this model's unit fought this phase, it can make a Fall Back move if within Engagement Range of an enemy unit, or otherwise a Normal move.

name: Swift Onslaught
summary: While this model leads a unit, Charge rolls made for that unit can be re-rolled.

name: Swooping Dive
summary: Once per battle, this unit can be targeted with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem for 0CP, even if a different unit was already targeted with it this phase.

name: Tactical Perception
summary: While this model leads a unit, models in that unit have the Fights First ability.

name: Tarsis Buckler
summary: The bearer has a Wounds characteristic of 4.

name: Tenacious Spirit
summary: While this model leads a unit, its attacks gain +1 to the Hit roll if the unit is below its Starting Strength, and also +1 to the Wound roll if it is Below Half-strength.

name: Turbo-boost
summary: Each time this unit Advances, skip the Advance roll and instead add 6" to the Move characteristic of models in this unit until the end of the phase.

name: Unyielding Ancient
summary: The first time this model is destroyed, it is removed without triggering Deadly Demise; at the end of the phase, roll a D6 and on a 2+ it returns to the battlefield near where it fell, outside Engagement Range, with D6 wounds remaining.

name: Vexilla
summary: Models in the bearer's unit have their Objective Control characteristic increased by 1.

name: Martial Ka'tah
summary: Before this unit fights, choose a Ka'tah Stance for that activation: Dacatarai grants its melee weapons Sustained Hits 1; Rendax grants its melee weapons Lethal Hits.
